scope: posthoc descriptive; observed runtime controller statistics; no causal attribution

metric_definition.A: sum over heads and probes of ||m projection_b(S-R)||^2
metric_definition.marginal_gain: -dJ/dalpha at alpha=.25 after dividing by T+N = 1.5*(T-N)/(T+N)
metric_definition.local_optimum: offline objective summary, no smoothing; NOT an additional generated run
metric_definition.role_eta_squared: sum within-call between-role SS / sum within-call total SS; descriptive, not p-value
